problem_statement: NVS mount fails when a power loss occurs during programming of the last ATE of a sector, leaving the sector logically full (the data write address has advanced to the ATE write address with no erased space remaining) but recoverable via garbage collection. In this situation nvs_mount() should still succeed: the sector is treated as closed and garbage collection is triggered on the next write. Instead, startup returns a non-zero error and the filesystem fails to mount.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/subsys/fs/nvs -s tests/subsys/fs/nvs/filesystem.nvs -s filesystem.nvs -O twister-out --no-clean -W
